protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: Real same-host path traversal on the configured image-factory host. Source: Operator-authorized managementServer.CreateSchematic in internal/backend/grpc/schematics.go accepts caller-controlled CreateSchematicRequest.TalosVersion. At first write 7486bb8d20d42b6c2fddda9e641bca55601b1dd9, if InstallationMedia.Overlay is set and quirks.New(request.TalosVersion).SupportsOverlay() is true, Omni calls s.imageFactoryClient.Client.OverlaysVersions(ctx, request.TalosVersion) with no validation; errors are wrapped back to the caller. quirks.SupportsOverlay (talos machinery) treats a ParseTolerant failure as latest Talos (returns true), so a ../-bearing non-semver version still reaches the sink. Sink: github.com/siderolabs/image-factory v0.3.1 pkg/client OverlaysVersions interpolates fmt.Sprintf("/version/%s/overlays/official", talosVersion) then http.NewRequest on c.baseURL.JoinPath(uri), so ../ is normalized on the factory host; checkError reflects up to 8192 bytes of HTTP error body. Vendor GHSA-c66c-vq6w-fvh5 (published 2026-06-05, withdrawn_at null) matches this chain. CVE.org/cveawg record for CVE-2026-45723 is DNE, but the vendor advisory is live and the trees reproduce the bug, so this is not a withdrawn/rejected FALSE_POSITIVE.
